title: Independent Report on Hairline Cracks Found on 26 MRT Trains
what_it_is: Independent Report on Hairline Cracks Found on 26 MRT Trains

sections.label: TUV Rheinland train safety report
sections.summary: TUV Rheinland assessed the trains safe and the cracks' root cause as an inherent bolster defect; publishing the report needs the consultant's written permission.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: TUV Rheinland's technical report assessed that the trains are safe to operate.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: It also assessed that the primary root cause of the hairline cracks is the inherent defect in certain batches of the bolsters.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: We have no objection to make public the consultant's report.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: However, as the contract contains a confidentiality clause whereby written permission from the consultant has to be granted, we will put the request to them.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr Khaw Boon Wan)
sentences.text: If they have no objection, we will have it published on the Land Transport Authority website.

sections.label: Bolster defect cause and rectification
sections.summary: The report checked the bolster defect's reason and found impurity during manufacturing; the manufacturers decided to get new bolsters and car-body.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The report was purely to check firstly, what is the reason for the bolster defect and it established that there was impurity during the manufacturing process.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: The decision to rectify this problem by getting new bolsters and to get the new car-body was made by the manufacturers.

sections.label: Replacing bolster with impurities
sections.summary: The bolster must be replaced because it has impurities in it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Khaw Boon Wan
sentences.text: You must replace the bolster because it has impurities in it.
